name: nfc-vcards
description: NFC & vCard SaaS - Node.js (Express + Sequelize/MySQL) API and React (Vite) website and portals

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.db:setup: npm --prefix server run db:sync && npm --prefix server run db:seed
scripts.build: npm --prefix server ci --omit=dev && npm --prefix client ci --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.start: node server/src/scripts/sync.js --safe && node server/src/scripts/seed.js && node server/src/index.js
